conditions: User opens the language menu and selects German (Deutsch)
items.expected: The shop's labels (e.g. navigation items, page headings) are displayed in German after selecting the language

conditions: User selects German as the language
items.expected: The language button shows the selected language code (e.g. 'DE') immediately after selection; after page reload, the shop's labels remain in German, not reverting to English

conditions: Shop starts in English with lang='en'
User selects German from the language menu
items.expected: The language button shows the selected language code (e.g. 'DE') confirming the selection was applied; the document's lang attribute changes to the German language code (e.g. 'de')

conditions: Shop home page loaded in default language
items.expected: No WCAG A/AA violations reported by axe-core on the top bar language selection area

excluded.reason: Order tracking shows any order to anyone — this is about order tracking access control, which belongs to SCRUM-27, not this story's language-switching behaviour
Session token still accepted after logout — this is about session/authentication management, not language selection; it does not touch any AC of SCRUM-26
Both open bugs (SCRUM-28, SCRUM-12) are Active but touch other stories' behaviour, not language selection; no confirmation item is needed here

Language preference is a UI-only setting stored client-side; the story and its context imply no authentication, account enumeration, or data-protection concern — there is no security surface to test here
